first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public University of Exeter rooftop/building Polygon/MultiPolygon feature payload for an Exeter-campus building, with the building identity and evidence-bearing type/use attributes bound to the same official feature. The public Roof Access Safety Dashboard states that it provides detailed building-specific roof data across the Streatham and St Luke’s Exeter campuses and includes university-rooftop layers, but the selected public item window exposes only application/coverage metadata and terms, not a dereferenceable record geometry payload or record-bound building type/use fields; therefore source-area metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
method_change: Ordnance Survey OS Downloads API OpenMapLocal SX GeoPackage -> University of Exeter Digital Estate Team public ArcGIS Roof Access Safety application/rooftop-layer metadata; institution-owned Exeter building-data surface, no spatial join or image tracing.
